name: DeletePackageVersionsResult
description: DeletePackageVersionsResult schema from Amazon CodeArtifact API

allOf.description: A list of the package versions that were successfully deleted. The status of every successful version will be Deleted.

A PackageVersionError object that contains a map of errors codes for the deleted package that failed. The possible error codes are:

  • ALREADY_EXISTS

  • MISMATCHED_REVISION

  • MISMATCHED_STATUS

  • NOT_ALLOWED

  • NOT_FOUND

  • SKIPPED
